name: asd-ste100
description: Rewrite ambiguous English into ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English so agents and readers cannot misread it.

interface.shortDescription: Rewrite English so it has one reading.
interface.longDescription: Applies the ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English rules to text that an agent or a downstream system must parse without a human to resolve ambiguity: tool descriptions, error messages, inter-agent instructions, and status reports. Ships a stdlib-only linter for the structural rules. Vendored unedited from danyuchn/asd-ste100-skill.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this error message in Simplified Technical English.
Make this tool description impossible for an agent to misread.
